result.reason: The clause largely tracks the preferred position, including six months of transition assistance at then-current rates and certified deletion. However, the 30-day data-return period runs from Customer's request rather than expiry or termination, so it does not ensure export within 30 days of the exit event. More importantly, termination of any single Service Option Attachment triggers return and deletion of all Customer data, potentially disrupting unaffected attachments that remain in force and conflicting with the original clause's intent. It should limit attachment-level obligations to the terminated services and associated data, while applying the broader obligation upon termination of the entire Agreement. “Thereafter” also leaves the deletion timing unclear, particularly if no export is requested. The margin comment does not cure these operative issues.
